sections.description:
NORTH WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE WORKERS' CHILDREN EDUCATION CESS
(UTILIZATION) RULES, 1981
NORTH WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE WORKERS' CHILDREN EDUCATION CESS (UTILIZATION) RULES, 1981
(Published
under Noti. SOL/1‑17 August 18, 1981, N.W.F.P. Govt .Gaz. Extr 4 Oct
1981. p, 140,)
[No. 30L/1‑17.‑18th
August 1981.‑‑‑In exercise of the powers conferred by section
6 of the Workers' Children (Education)
Ordinance, 1971 (XI of 1972), the Government of the. North‑West Frontier
Province is pleased to stake the following rules.]
1. Short title extent and commencement.‑‑(1) These
rules may be called the North‑West Frontier Province Workers' Children
Education Cess (Utilization) Rules, 1381.
(2) They shall extend to the
whole of the North‑West Frontier Province:
(3) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.‑--In these rules, unless there is anything
repugant in the subject or context,
(a) "Board" means the
Board constituted under rule 3 ;
(c) "Committee" means a
District Committee constituted under rule 5 ;
(d) "Education"
includes all types of education, whether general, vocational, technical or
professional in a recognized school, college, university or other institution ;
(e) "Government" means
the Government of the North‑West Frontier Province ;
(f) "Member" means a
member of the Board. or, as the case may be a Committee ; and
(g) "Ordinance" means
Workers' Children (Education) Ordinance, 1972 (XI of 1972).
3. Constitution of Board.‑‑(1) As soon as may be after
the commencement of these rules, Government shall, by a notification in the
official Gazette, constitute a Board for the North‑West Frontier
Province, consisting of :‑-
(a) the Secretary to Government
of North‑West Frontier Province, Labour Department, who shall also be its
Chairman ;
(b) the Secretary to Government
of North‑West Frontier Province, Finance :department or his nominee not
below the rank of a Deputy Secretary;
(c) the Secretary to Government
of North‑West Frontier Province, Education Department or his nominee not
below the rank of a Deputy Secretary ;
(d) the Secretary to Government
of North‑West Frontier Province, Excise and Taxation Department or his
nominee not below the rank of Deputy Secretary ;
(e) the Director of Education
(Schools), North‑West Frontier Province ;
(f) the Director of Education
(Colleges), North‑West Frontier Province ;
(g) the Director of Technical
Education, North‑West Frontier Province ;
(h) the Director, Labour
Welfare,, North‑West Frontier Province ;
(i) the Deputy Secretary
(Labour), Government of North‑West Frontier Province, Labour Department,
who shall also be its Secretary ;
(j) three representatives of
workers to be nominated by Govern ment ; and
(k) three representatives of
employers.
4. Functions and Powers of the Board.‑---The Board shall
(a) review the collection of
education cess ;
(b) call for any information from
such establishment liable to pay education cess in respect of workers' children
as it considers education and shall maintain upto‑date record of such
information----
(c) lay down policy for
utilization of education cess collected under the Ordinance ;
(d) approve the annual budget;
(e) allocate finds out of the
collection of education cess to the District committee.
(f) authorise the Chairman of
Committees to make appointment of staff ;
(g) in our expenditure on the
management tend administration of the Board and Committees ;
(h) call for any information
from, or Give direction to, Committees ;
(i) regulate proceedings of tire
Board ;
(j) do any other thing necessary
for, or connected with, or incidental to, the discharge of its functions under
the Ordinance and these rules.
5. Constitution of District Committees.‑‑-(1) The Board
shall, by notification in the official Gazette, constitute a District Committee
for each Much District in the Province which it considers expedient for the
purposes of the Ordinance and these rules.
(2) The Committee shelf consist
of‑
(a) the Deputy Commissioner of
the District concerned
